brief.reuse: 材料未说明。

de9d54a5ca874df6.text: As LLM-based conversational agents advance toward increasingly open-ended and interaction-intensive scenarios, task completion alone provides an incomplete assessment of their effectiveness. The evolution of users' internal states, including beliefs, desires, intentions, and emotions (BDI/E), serves as an intermediate signal connecting agent behaviors with interaction outcomes and reflects how conversational strategies shape users during multi-turn interactions. However, existing evaluation paradigms primarily focus on surface-level responses or final outcomes, providing limited insight into the underlying cognitive processes. This limitation makes it difficult to diagnose why agents succeed or fail and to optimize their interaction strategies. To address this challenge, we propose Cognitive World Model (CogWM), an LLM-based cognitive user model that jointly models users' BDI/E states and corresponding responses, enabling explicit cognitive trajectory tracking. Trained on 150K user-turn samples with Qwen3-14B, CogWM achieves superior performance over existing user simulation baselines in both response fidelity and cognitive state understanding. Interactions with six state-of-the-art LLMs demonstrate that CogWM enables progressive comparison of agents through cognitive trajectories, revealing distinct agent patterns and complementary relationships between cognitive evolution and behavioral outcomes.

d2b07b1b576be714.text: AI scientist systems are beginning to automate parts of scientific research, but social science poses a distinct challenge: its objects of inquiry are not merely datasets or laboratory protocols, but integrated social processes involving situated participants, interaction contexts, interventions, and outcomes. Yet a critical link is missing: existing systems either assist isolated research tasks or simulate agents as experimental subjects, leaving the research workflow and simulated society decoupled. Here we introduce AgentSociety 2, an Integrated Research Environment for executable social science. It couples two roles of LLM agents in the same runtime: AI social scientists that coordinate literature grounding, hypothesis generation, experiment design, simulation execution, result interpretation, and manuscript drafting; and silicon participants that generate behavioral responses within configurable social environments. This dual-role design turns hypotheses into auditable agent behaviors, environment rules, interventions, and measurements, thereby supporting an end-to-end workflow. Across seven illustrative studies spanning micro-level social-science laboratory experiments, meso-level dynamics in social media, and macro-level urban scenarios, we demonstrate its capacity to support diverse disciplinary questions, reproduce major qualitative patterns from prior studies, identify informative deviations, and enable large-scale simulations through optimized agent-environment interactions. By preserving human researchers' high-level agency while delegating procedural orchestration to agentic systems, it provides a human-in-the-loop and controllable infrastructure for next-generation computational social science, with broader applications in scalable computational social experimentation and AI-enabled social governance platforms.
d2b07b1b576be714.abstract_zh: AI 科学家系统已经开始自动化部分科研工作，但社会科学的对象不只是数据集或实验流程，而是包含参与者、互动情境、干预和结果的完整社会过程。作者指出目前缺一环：现有系统要么只辅助孤立的研究任务，要么只把智能体当作实验被试来模拟，研究工作流和模拟社会是脱节的。AgentSociety 2 是一个面向可执行社会科学的一体化研究环境，把两类 LLM 智能体耦合在同一运行时里。AI 社会学家负责协调文献梳理、假设生成、实验设计、仿真执行、结果解释和论文撰写；硅基被试在可配置的社会环境里生成行为响应。这种双角色设计把假设转成可审计的智能体行为、环境规则、干预和测量，支撑端到端的工作流。作者用七项示例研究验证，覆盖微观层面的社会科学实验室实验、中观层面的社交媒体动态和宏观层面的城市场景，展示了系统支持多样学科问题的能力：复现既有研究的主要定性模式、识别有信息量的偏差，并通过优化的智能体-环境交互实现大规模仿真。系统保留人类研究者的高层主导权，把流程性编排交给智能体系统，是一个人在回路、可控的计算社会科学基础设施，也可用于可扩展的计算社会实验和 AI 辅助的社会治理平台。
d2b07b1b576be714.why: 它把 AI 科学家工作流和 LLM 社会仿真两条线接到了同一运行时里，做仿真推演的人可以直接看它如何把假设转成可审计的环境规则、干预和测量，以及七项跨尺度研究里复现与偏差的具体表现。

brief.question: 解决现有系统要么只辅助孤立研究任务、要么只把智能体当实验对象，导致研究流程与模拟社会脱节的问题，目标是让社会科学研究可执行、端到端。
brief.setup: 同一运行时中耦合两类 LLM 智能体：AI social scientists 负责文献梳理、假设生成、实验设计、仿真执行、结果解释和论文撰写；silicon participants 在可配置的社会环境中生成行为反应。材料未说明具体模型和智能体数量。
brief.method: 双角色设计，把假设转化为可审计的智能体行为、环境规则、干预和测量，由智能体系统承担流程编排，人类研究者保留高层控制权（human-in-the-loop）。
brief.findings: 在七个示例研究中覆盖微观社会心理学实验、中观社交媒体动态和宏观城市场景，能复现既有研究的主要定性模式、识别有信息量的偏差，并通过优化智能体与环境交互支持大规模仿真。
brief.validation: 与既有研究的定性模式对比，能复现其主要结果；未说明具体误差数字或定量对比强度。
brief.limits: 材料未说明。
brief.reuse: AgentSociety 2 作为集成研究环境本身可复用，支持可配置社会环境、干预和测量；代码或数据可用性未说明。

d49a28d2bcc3bca0.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as decision-making components in social simulations. This introduces a methodological risk: the simulation may deviate from the explicit behavioral policy defined by the researcher. In online social network (OSN) simulations, action choices shape system dynamics, interaction patterns, and model interpretability. This paper evaluates whether LLM action selectors preserve an interpretable reference policy in an OSN simulation. The reference is a finite state machine implemented as a first-order Markov model, with transition probabilities depending on the user type. The evaluation uses a synthetic network with 1,000 agents and 10,000 action decisions. Three open-weight LLMs are tested: LLaMA 3.1, GPT-OSS, and Mistral 24B. Each model is evaluated under three prompting strategies: base, guided, and probabilistic. Alignment is measured using Jensen-Shannon Divergence with Laplace smoothing, and execution time is reported. Results show that LLMs can approximate the reference policy in some configurations, but do not preserve it reliably. Alignment varies across models and prompts, and additional guidance can introduce systematic action biases. Even the best-aligned LLM configurations are several hundred times slower than direct Markov chain sampling. These findings indicate that LLM-based action selection is not a direct replacement for explicit decision policies: it can alter the intended behavior while increasing computational cost.
d49a28d2bcc3bca0.abstract_zh:
LLM 越来越多地被用作社会仿真中的决策组件，这带来一个方法学风险：仿真可能偏离研究者明确设定的行为策略。在在线社交网络（OSN）仿真里，动作选择决定了系统动态、交互模式和模型可解释性。这篇论文要回答的问题是：LLM 做动作选择时，能否保持一个可解释的参考策略？

参考策略是一个用一阶马尔可夫模型实现的有限状态机，转移概率取决于用户类型。评测在一个含 1000 个智能体的合成网络上进行，共 10000 次动作决策。作者测试了三个开源权重模型：LLaMA 3.1、GPT-OSS 和 Mistral 24B，每个模型分别在基础、引导和概率三种提示策略下评测。对齐程度用带 Laplace 平滑的 Jensen-Shannon 散度衡量，同时报告执行时间。

结果显示，某些配置下 LLM 能近似参考策略，但不能可靠地保持它。对齐程度随模型和提示方式变化，额外的引导反而会引入系统性的动作偏差。即便是对齐最好的 LLM 配置，也比直接马尔可夫链采样慢数百倍。作者的结论是，基于 LLM 的动作选择不能直接替代显式决策策略：它会在增加计算成本的同时改变预期行为。
d49a28d2bcc3bca0.why: 它给“用 LLM 替代显式行为规则”这一流行做法提供了反例和量化证据，做社会仿真的人在引入 LLM 决策前应该先看这份对齐测量结果。

dc2a8ca54310bc66.text: Understanding how educational social dynamics evolve is critical for informing effective educational policies and counterfactual interventions. However, traditional methods face a fundamental dilemma: observational studies often lack causal power, while controlled experiments are frequently constrained by ethical concerns. Although LLM-based multi-agent simulations offer a scalable in silico alternative, existing approaches remain limited by weak psychological grounding and insufficient measurement of latent psychological states. To address this, we introduce EduMirror, a multi-agent simulator for the scientific study of educational social dynamics. We provide configurable education-oriented agent forms, including value-driven agents grounded in psychological needs and social value orientation, together with a dual-track measurement protocol for quantifying observable behaviors and latent psychological states. We validate the realism and usability of EduMirror through case studies on school bullying and group cooperation, as well as broader evaluations across diverse educational scenarios. The results show that EduMirror generates educational social dynamics that are realistic, theory-consistent, and measurable by empirical criteria. These properties enable structured in silico educational research, providing a computational tool for hypothesis testing and counterfactual intervention analysis in educational science. Project page: https://edumirror.net.
dc2a8ca54310bc66.abstract_zh:
研究教育中的社会动态对制定教育政策和做反事实干预分析很重要，但传统方法有困境：观察性研究缺乏因果推断能力，受控实验又常受伦理限制。基于大语言模型的多智能体仿真提供了可扩展的计算实验途径，但现有方法心理基础薄弱，对潜在心理状态的测量也不足。

为此作者提出 EduMirror，一个用于科学地研究教育社会动态的多智能体仿真器。它提供可配置的、面向教育的智能体形态，包括以心理需求和社会价值取向为基础的价值驱动智能体，并设计了双轨测量协议，分别量化可观察行为和潜在心理状态。

作者通过校园欺凌和群体合作的案例研究，以及在多种教育场景下的更广泛评测，验证了 EduMirror 的真实性和可用性。结果显示它生成的教育社会动态是真实的、与理论一致的，并且可以用实证标准来度量。这些性质使得结构化的计算教育研究成为可能，为教育科学中的假设检验和反事实干预分析提供了计算工具。
dc2a8ca54310bc66.why: 它把心理需求和社会价值取向嵌入智能体设计，并给出测量潜在心理状态的双轨协议，为教育政策推演和反事实干预分析提供了一个可复用的仿真工具。

brief.question: 研究教育场景中的社会动态演化，为教育政策和反事实干预提供可扩展的 in silico 研究手段，替代因果效力不足的观察研究和受伦理限制的对照实验。
brief.setup: EduMirror 是一个面向教育社会动态的多智能体模拟器，提供可配置的教育导向智能体形式，包括基于心理需求和社会价值取向（social value orientation）的价值驱动智能体。具体智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 提出双轨测量协议（dual-track measurement protocol），同时量化可观察行为和潜在心理状态，弥补现有 LLM 多智能体仿真心理基础薄弱、潜在心理状态测量不足的问题。
brief.findings: 在校园欺凌和群体合作两个案例研究以及多个教育场景的评估中，EduMirror 生成的教育社会动态被判定为真实、与理论一致、且可按实证标准测量。材料未给出具体数字。
brief.validation: 通过校园欺凌和群体合作的案例研究以及跨多种教育场景的评估来验证真实性和可用性，未说明与真实数据对比的量化误差或消融实验。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: 项目页面 https://edumirror.net，提供可配置智能体形式和双轨测量协议，可用于假设检验和反事实干预分析。代码和数据是否公开未说明。

da3799bd19d35a3a.text: Human behaviour during epidemics affects infectious disease dynamics, but quantifying this remains deeply challenging. Here we introduce the Epi-LLM framework: a novel integration of agent-based modelling, real-life epigames, and large language models (LLMs) in which a synthetic society of agents reasons and adapts dynamically over an outbreak contact network. Comparing synthetic agent behaviour against a no-intervention SEIR baseline and human participant data from the AUIB epigame study, we find that LLM agents across four different architectures reduced peak active infections, with quarantine compliance peaking at 58-65% on day six of the 15-day simulation. A binomial generalised linear model showed that perceived health severity was the strongest predictor of quarantine behaviour ($β= 0.33, p = 0.002$), yielding a pseudo-$R^2$ of 0.055, comparable to the 0.072 observed in the human trial. LLM architecture is a key determinant of epidemic dynamics: low-variance architectures offer greater internal validity for testing behavioural rules, while high-variance models may better represent real-world decision-making. Geographic labels alone do not induce culturally differentiated behaviour; explicit attitudinal parameterisation is required. This proof-of-principle work lays the groundwork for deploying the Epi-LLM framework as a scalable, risk-free simulation environment for pandemic preparedness research.
da3799bd19d35a3a.abstract_zh:
流行病中的人类行为会影响传染病动态，但量化这种影响一直很难。作者提出 Epi-LLM 框架，把基于智能体的建模、真实生活中的 epigame 博弈实验和大语言模型整合起来：一个合成智能体社会在疫情暴发的接触网络上推理并动态调整行为。

实验以无干预的 SEIR 模型为基线，并对照 AUIB epigame 研究中的真人参与者数据。四种不同 LLM 架构下的智能体都降低了活跃感染峰值，在 15 天模拟的第六天，隔离服从率达到峰值 58–65%。二项广义线性模型显示，感知到的健康严重度是隔离行为的最强预测因子（β=0.33，p=0.002），伪 R² 为 0.055，与真人实验中的 0.072 相当。

LLM 架构本身是疫情动态的关键决定因素：低方差架构在测试行为规则时内部效度更高，高方差模型可能更能代表真实世界的决策。仅靠地理标签不会引发文化差异化的行为，需要显式的态度参数化。作者认为这项原理验证工作为把 Epi-LLM 用作可扩展、无风险的疫情准备研究仿真环境打下了基础。
da3799bd19d35a3a.why: 它给出了一个把 LLM 智能体行为与真人实验数据直接对齐的流行病仿真框架，并报告了架构方差、文化参数化对结果的具体影响，对做公共卫生推演的人有直接参考价值。

brief.question: 量化疫情中人类行为对传染病动态的影响，这一直很难测量。作者用 LLM 智能体仿真来推演疫情暴发期间个体行为（如隔离依从）如何改变感染动态。
brief.setup: 合成社会的 LLM 智能体在疫情接触网络上推理和动态适应，仿真时长 15 天。对比了四种不同的 LLM 架构，并与无干预的 SEIR 基线以及 AUIB epigame 研究中的人类被试数据对照。具体智能体数量和所用模型名称未说明。
brief.method: Epi-LLM 框架，整合了 agent-based modelling、真实 epigame 和 LLM，让智能体在暴发接触网络中动态推理和适应。用二项广义线性模型分析隔离行为的预测因素。
brief.findings: 四种架构的 LLM 智能体都降低了峰值活跃感染数，隔离依从率在第 6 天达到峰值 58-65%（仿真共 15 天）。感知健康严重度是隔离行为的最强预测因子（β=0.33, p=0.002），伪 R² 为 0.055，与人类试验的 0.072 相当。低方差架构内部效度更高，适合测试行为规则；高方差模型可能更贴近真实决策。仅靠地理标签不会引发文化差异化的行为，需要显式的态度参数化。
brief.validation: 与无干预 SEIR 基线对比确认行为效应，与 AUIB epigame 人类被试数据对比，行为模型的伪 R²（0.055 vs 0.072）接近人类水平。验证强度中等：行为预测力与人类相当，但整体是 proof-of-principle 工作。
brief.limits: 作者自述为 proof-of-principle，伪 R² 只有 0.055，解释力有限。地理标签无法诱导文化差异行为，说明行为参数化仍需显式设定。其他局限未说明。
brief.reuse: Epi-LLM 框架本身，可作为可扩展、无风险的疫情准备研究仿真环境；低方差/高方差架构的选择经验；显式态度参数化的做法。代码和数据可用性未说明。

d115faee9f57d639.text: Healthcare mechanisms are inseparable from the strategic provider response they induce: existing healthcare AI benchmarks hold this response fixed and so cannot evaluate mechanisms by the equilibrium they produce. We recast hospital mechanism design as program synthesis for language models: typed, inspectable rule programs are executed and scored by Medi-Sim, a multi-agent simulator with five strategic provider channels (coding, selection, delay, effort, triage). An incentive sweep recovers classical health-economics findings as adjacent regimes -- up-coding and low-complexity-patient selection under profit pressure, and Goodhart-style drift where measured performance becomes anti-correlated with true outcomes -- and a single audit lever exposes pressure migration: closing the coding channel more than doubles low-complexity selection. LLM-guided evolutionary code search over the same rule-program space then synthesizes an inspectable mixed-objective program that eliminates up-coding, halves rejection, and retains most of the profit-oriented baseline's funds.
d115faee9f57d639.abstract_zh:
医疗机制的效果取决于它诱发的供方策略反应，而现有医疗 AI 基准把这种反应固定住，无法按均衡结果评估机制。作者把医院机制设计改写为大模型的程序合成问题：规则程序是带类型、可检查的代码，由多智能体仿真器 Medi-Sim 执行并打分。Medi-Sim 建模了供方的五条策略渠道：编码、病人选择、延迟、努力和分诊。

作者先做激励扫描，在相邻参数区间里复现了健康经济学的经典发现：利润压力下出现高编码和低复杂度病人选择；被测量的绩效指标与真实结果反相关，即 Goodhart 式漂移。他们还发现单一审计杠杆会引发压力迁移：关闭编码渠道后，低复杂度选择行为增加一倍以上。

在此基础上，作者用 LLM 引导的演化代码搜索在同一规则程序空间里合成出一个可检查的混合目标程序。这个程序消除了高编码，把拒诊率减半，同时保留了以利润为导向的基线的大部分资金。
d115faee9f57d639.why: 它把机制设计变成可执行、可检查的代码搜索，并用多智能体仿真按均衡而非固定行为来评分，这套做法可以直接搬到政策推演和其他机制评估场景；激励扫描复现经典健康经济学结论，也给了仿真可信度一个参照。

brief.question: 医院机制设计如何评估？现有医疗 AI 基准把医疗服务提供方的策略性反应固定住，无法按均衡结果评估机制，作者要推演的是机制在策略性反应下的真实表现。
brief.setup: Medi-Sim 多智能体模拟器，含五个策略性提供方通道（coding、selection、delay、effort、triage），对类型化、可检查的规则程序进行执行和打分。智能体数量、环境细节、时间尺度和使用的模型均未说明。
brief.method: 把医院机制设计改写为面向语言模型的程序合成：规则程序可执行、可检查，用 LLM 引导的进化式代码搜索在同一规则程序空间里搜索，并做激励扫描（incentive sweep）。
brief.findings: 激励扫描复现了经典卫生经济学结论：利润压力下出现 up-coding 和低复杂度病人选择，以及 Goodhart 式漂移（被测绩效与真实结果负相关）。单一审计杠杆暴露压力迁移：关闭 coding 通道后低复杂度选择翻倍以上。进化搜索合成出一个可检查的混合目标程序，消除了 up-coding，拒绝率减半，并保留了利润导向基线的大部分资金。
brief.validation: 通过激励扫描复现经典卫生经济学结论（up-coding、低复杂度选择、Goodhart 漂移）作为间接验证，未说明与真实医疗数据或人类基线的定量对比。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: Medi-Sim 多智能体模拟器、五个策略性通道的建模方式、类型化可检查规则程序的机制表示、LLM 引导的进化代码搜索流程。代码和数据是否公开未说明。

d6ca2118dda38265.text: Proactive task-oriented dialogue (TOD), such as outbound sales, demands a persuasive agent that actively probes the user's concerns and steers the conversation toward acceptance within a bounded number of turns. Yet post-trained LLMs are inherently conservative, and reward-shaping RL (e.g., GRPO) struggles since it only re-weights what an already passive policy samples. We show that conditioning on the user's latent concerns unlocks proactive capability that no amount of sampling can undermine, establishing these concerns as a pivotal training-time signal. To operationalize this finding, we build the \textbf{Cognitive User Simulator}, which models each user as a stratified persona comprising observable external traits and hidden internal concerns. The simulator produces faithful and diverse interactions, while emitting per-turn state dynamics that track persuasion progress. We then introduce \textbf{Simulator-Induced Asymmetric-View Policy Optimization}, which converts the modeled concerns and the simulation state transition into complementary training objectives: (1) \emph{Asymmetric On-Policy Self-Distillation} that transfers concern-aware behavior from a privileged view of the same policy into its deployable, conversation-only view; and (2) \emph{State-Transition Policy Refinement} ...

d81f4e506b745d9f.text: Humans learn social norms and behaviors from verbal feedback (e.g., a parent saying "that was rude" or a friend explaining "here's why that hurt"). Yet, learning from feedback for LLMs has largely focused on domains like code and math, where RL rewards are directly verifiable and condensed into scalar values. As LLMs are increasingly used to simulate human behavior, e.g., standing in for users, patients, students, and other personas, there is a pressing need to make them more human-like, which requires embracing a fundamentally different kind of signal: feedback that is verbal, subjective, and multi-faceted. We present DITTO, a model trained by treating verbal feedback as a first-class signal in reinforcement learning. After each rollout, DITTO receives verbal feedback and generates a feedback-conditioned improved rollout; both outputs are jointly optimized with GRPO, distilling verbal guidance into the base policy without requiring feedback at test time. We also introduce SOUL (Simulation gym Of hUman-Like behavior), a unified benchmark and training data suite spanning 10 tasks across six categories: Theory of Mind, character role play, social skill, learner simulation, user simulation, and persona simulation. DITTO achieves an average 36% improvement over the base model and exceeds GPT-5.4 on 6 of 10 SOUL benchmarks, demonstrating that RL with verbal feedback is a promising direction for training LLMs to simulate human behavior.
d81f4e506b745d9f.abstract_zh:
人类靠语言反馈学习社会规范和行为，比如家长说“那样很没礼貌”。而大模型从反馈中学习的已有工作集中在代码和数学这类领域，奖励可以验证并压缩成标量。当大模型被用来模拟用户、病人、学生等角色时，需要一种不同的信号：语言的、主观的、多方面的反馈。

作者提出 DITTO，把语言反馈作为强化学习的一等信号。每次 rollout 后，DITTO 接收语言反馈，生成一个以反馈为条件的改进 rollout，两个输出用 GRPO 联合优化，把语言指导蒸馏进基础策略，测试时不需要反馈。作者还发布 SOUL，一个统一的行为模拟基准和训练数据集，覆盖六类共 10 项任务：心智理论、角色扮演、社交技能、学习者模拟、用户模拟和人格模拟。

DITTO 比基础模型平均提升 36%，在 10 项 SOUL 基准中的 6 项上超过 GPT-5.4。作者认为用语言反馈做强化学习是训练大模型模拟人类行为的一个有前景的方向。
d81f4e506b745d9f.why: 它把语言反馈引入 RL 训练流程，给做人类行为仿真的研究者提供了新的训练方法和一套可直接使用的 SOUL 基准与数据。

brief.question: 如何让 LLM 在模拟人类行为（用户、患者、学生等角色）时更像真人，即学会从言语反馈中改进行为，而不是只依赖代码、数学这类可验证奖励。
brief.setup: 提出 DITTO 模型，基于基础模型训练；配套 SOUL 基准，覆盖 Theory of Mind、角色扮演、社交技能、学习者模拟、用户模拟、人格模拟六类共 10 个任务。智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 每次 rollout 后给 DITTO 言语反馈，让它生成一个以反馈为条件的改进版 rollout，两个输出用 GRPO 联合优化，把言语指导蒸馏进基础策略，测试时不需要反馈。
brief.findings: DITTO 比基础模型平均提升 36%，在 10 个 SOUL 基准中的 6 个上超过 GPT-5.4。
brief.validation: 与基础模型和 GPT-5.4 在 SOUL 基准上对比，未说明是否与真实人类数据对比或做消融。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: SOUL 基准与训练数据套件可作为统一评测集；把言语反馈作为一等 RL 信号、用反馈条件 rollout 对做 GRPO 联合优化的训练方法可直接借鉴。代码是否开源未说明。

d63f03e2dcb1fcf4.text: Classical models of opinion dynamics assume human participants with bounded rationality and limited coordination. The rise of LLM-based agents introduces a qualitative shift: agents can now participate in online discussions at scale, maintain consistent persuasion strategies, and coordinate systematically. This paper argues that LLM agents make collective belief dynamics programmable, enabling deliberate steering of population-level beliefs. We term this emerging problem programmable collective belief control. Through controlled multi-agent simulations, we provide proof-of-concept evidence that coordinated AI agents can induce measurable belief shifts that stabilize within a few interaction rounds. We identify four structural properties (indistinguishability, persistence, contextuality, and configurability) that make detection and defense fundamentally difficult. Based on these findings, we outline a research agenda spanning theoretical foundations for adversarial belief dynamics, operational methods for system-level detection and intervention, and simulation infrastructure for scalable experimentation. Our goal is not to present a complete solution, but to articulate why this problem demands urgent attention and to provide a conceptual foundation for future work.
d63f03e2dcb1fcf4.abstract_zh: 经典舆论动力学模型假设参与者是有限理性、协调能力有限的人类。LLM 智能体的出现带来质变：智能体可以大规模参与在线讨论，保持一致的劝说策略，并进行系统性协同。论文的核心论点是，LLM 智能体让集体信念动态变得可编程，即可以刻意引导人群层面的信念走向，作者把这个问题称为可编程集体信念控制。作者做了受控的多智能体仿真，给出概念验证证据：协同的 AI 智能体能够诱导可测量的信念偏移，且这种偏移在几轮交互内就稳定下来。他们进一步指出四个结构性性质使检测和防御在根本上困难：不可区分性、持久性、情境性和可配置性。基于这些发现，论文提出一个研究议程，包括对抗性信念动力学的理论基础、系统级检测与干预的运行方法，以及支持可扩展实验的仿真基础设施。作者声明目标不是给出完整解决方案，而是说明这个问题为何需要紧迫关注，并为后续工作提供概念基础。
d63f03e2dcb1fcf4.why: 它用仿真实证了协同 LLM 智能体操纵群体信念的可行性，并给出检测防御困难的四个结构性原因，对做舆论仿真和平台安全推演的人是直接的预警和研究路线图。

brief.question: 推演的问题是有组织的 LLM 智能体能否系统性操纵群体信念，作者称之为 programmable collective belief control。
brief.setup: 受控多智能体仿真，具体智能体数量、环境、时间尺度和使用的模型均未说明。
brief.method: 让协调一致的 AI 智能体参与在线讨论，维持一致的劝说策略并系统性协作，观察群体信念变化。
brief.findings: 概念验证显示，协调的 AI 智能体能引发可测量的信念偏移，且在几轮交互内就趋于稳定。作者归纳出四个使检测和防御变得困难的性质：indistinguishability、persistence、contextuality、configurability。
brief.validation: 通过受控多智能体仿真提供概念验证证据，未说明与真实数据或人类基线的对比。
brief.limits: 作者明确表示这不是完整解决方案，只提供概念基础；检测与防御在结构上就很难实现。
brief.reuse: 可借鉴的是其提出的研究议程：对抗性信念动力学的理论基础、系统级检测与干预方法、可扩展的仿真实验基础设施。代码和数据未说明。

db5807f04cd66534.text: Social simulation provides a compelling testbed for studying social intelligence, where agents interact through multi-turn dialogues under evolving contexts and strategically adapting opponents. Such environments are inherently non-stationary, requiring agents to dynamically adjust their strategies over time. However, most Large Language Model (LLM) based social agents rely on static personas, while existing approaches for enhancing social intelligence, such as offline reinforcement learning or external planners, are ill-suited to these settings, typically assuming stationarity and incurring substantial training overhead. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{ALSO} (\textbf{A}dversarial on\textbf{L}ine \textbf{S}trategy \textbf{O}ptimization), the first framework for online strategy optimization in multi-agent social simulation. ALSO advances social adaptation through two key contributions. (1) ALSO formulates multi-turn interaction as an adversarial bandit problem, where combinations of static personas and dynamic strategy instructions are treated as arms, providing a principled solution to non-stationarity without relying on environmental stability assumptions. (2) To predict rewards and generalize sparse feedback in multi-turn dialogues, ALSO introduces a lightweight neural surrogate to predict rewards from interaction histories, enabling sample-efficient exploration and continuous online adaptation. Experiments on the Sotopia benchmark demonstrate that ALSO consistently outperforms static baselines and existing optimization methods in dynamic environments, validating the effectiveness of adversarial online strategy optimization for building robust social agents.

d49cc54bfddb9df9.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior, but their ability to simulate individual privacy decisions is not well understood. In this paper, we evaluate whether a core set of user persona attributes can drive LLMs to simulate individual-level privacy behavior across various contexts. We introduce PrivacySIM, an evaluation suite that benchmarks LLM simulation of user privacy behavior against the ground-truth responses of 1,000 real users. These users are drawn from five published user studies on privacy behavior spanning LLM healthcare consultations, conversational agents, and chatbots. Drawing on these user studies and prior work in privacy behavior, we hypothesize three persona facets as plausible predictors of privacy decision-making: demographics, previous experiences, and stated privacy attitudes. We condition nine frontier LLMs on subsets of these three facets and measure how often each model's response to a data-sharing scenario matches the user's actual response. Our findings show that (1) zero-shot conditioning on these facets consistently improves simulation quality, but the performance of the best model (40.4% accuracy) suggests that richer and more nuanced persona facets are needed to reliably align with users' mental models for privacy decisions. (2) A user's stated privacy attitudes alone are often not the best predictor because they can diverge from the user's actual privacy behavior. (3) Users with high AI/chatbot experience are the most challenging to simulate. PrivacySIM is a first step toward understanding and improving the capabilities of LLMs to simulate user privacy decisions. We release PrivacySIM to enable further evaluation of LLM privacy simulation.
d49cc54bfddb9df9.abstract_zh:
大模型越来越多地被用来模拟人类行为，但它们能否模拟个体层面的隐私决策，此前并不清楚。Flemings 和 Annavaram 提出了 PrivacySIM，一个评测大模型模拟用户隐私行为的套件，基准数据来自五项已发表的用户研究，覆盖医疗大模型咨询、对话智能体和聊天机器人等场景，共 1000 名真实用户对数据共享场景的真实回答。

做法上，作者从这些用户研究和隐私行为文献出发，假设三类画像维度可能预测隐私决策：人口统计信息、过往经历、以及用户自述的隐私态度。他们让九个前沿大模型在这三类维度的不同子集条件下，回答数据共享场景，再统计模型回答与用户真实回答的匹配率。

结果有三点。第一，零样本条件下加入这些画像维度能稳定提升模拟质量，但最好的模型也只有 40.4% 的准确率，说明要可靠对齐用户的隐私决策心智模型，需要更丰富、更细致的画像维度。第二，用户自述的隐私态度单独来看往往不是最好的预测因子，因为它可能与实际隐私行为不一致。第三，有丰富 AI 和聊天机器人使用经验的用户最难被模拟。作者发布了 PrivacySIM，供后续继续评测大模型的隐私行为模拟。
d49cc54bfddb9df9.why: 它给“大模型能否替代真人样本”这个问题提供了一个反例：在隐私决策这类敏感行为上，最好的模型也只有四成准确率，且自述态度与实际行为的偏差、高经验用户都是难点，做合成样本或用户仿真的研究者需要知道这个边界。

brief.question: LLM 能否在个体层面模拟用户的隐私决策行为，即用一组用户画像属性驱动 LLM 复现真实用户在数据共享场景中的选择。
brief.setup: 评测套件 PrivacySIM，基准数据来自 5 项已发表隐私行为用户研究（覆盖 LLM 医疗咨询、对话智能体、聊天机器人场景）中 1000 名真实用户的真实回答。测试了 9 个前沿 LLM，条件化于三类画像侧面：人口统计信息、过往经历、自述隐私态度。
brief.method: 对 9 个前沿 LLM 做零样本条件化，输入三类画像侧面的不同子集，让模型回答数据共享场景问题，统计其回答与用户真实回答的匹配率。
brief.findings: 零样本条件化这些画像侧面能持续提升模拟质量，但最佳模型准确率仅 40.4%，说明需要更丰富的画像侧面才能可靠对齐用户的隐私决策心智模型。用户自述的隐私态度单独使用往往不是最好的预测因子，因为它会偏离实际行为。AI/聊天机器人经验丰富的用户最难被模拟。
brief.validation: 与 1000 名真实用户在数据共享场景中的真实回答逐条对比，以匹配准确率作为指标；强度受限于最佳模型仅 40.4%，说明当前 LLM 模拟个体隐私决策的能力还很低。
brief.limits: 最佳模型准确率仅 40.4%，现有三类画像侧面不足以可靠模拟个体隐私决策；自述态度与实际行为存在分歧；高 AI/聊天机器人经验用户模拟效果最差。
brief.reuse: 作者公开了 PrivacySIM 评测套件，可用于进一步评测 LLM 的隐私行为模拟能力。

d0bc7790b99fd005.text: What happens when the strongest alliance member pressures a weaker member over territory and strategic control? We examine the Greenland sovereignty crisis as a stress test for LLM geopolitics, centered on the 2019-2026 U.S. push to acquire Greenland from the Kingdom of Denmark. The crisis nests two collective-action problems: Arctic strategic control and whether NATO can enforce alliance norms against the dominant member. We develop three games (asymmetric coercion; a NATO assurance game with a critical-mass tipping point; a triadic extensive-form game with social preferences) and test them with a multi-agent simulation in which eight frontier LLMs play six geopolitical roles (United States, Denmark, Greenland, NATO, Russia, Canada) across 3,604 completed games and 108,120 action observations. Using inverse game theory, we recover each model's structural utility parameters (alpha, beta, gamma, delta, eta) for material self-interest, reciprocity, inequality aversion, norm respect, and commitment consistency. Three findings stand out. First, all eight models become more escalatory under coercion framing (four-action escalation rises from 10.7% to 28.6%). Second, Chinese-origin models show systematically different power-weight profiles from Western-origin models when playing the U.S. role. Third, peaceful US acquisition emerges in only 1.9% of clean games and only 3 of 8 frontier models ever achieve it, most prominently DeepSeek V3.2, which executes a stable five-round playbook through the metropole. Prompts emphasizing jus cogens and self-determination reduce escalation back near baseline in the English-only confirmatory sample; multilingual contrasts are reported as exploratory sensitivity checks. We position this as a structural benchmark for LLM geopolitical behavior, complementing action-frequency benchmarks.
d0bc7790b99fd005.abstract_zh:
这篇论文研究一个联盟内部问题：最强的成员向较弱的成员施压，争夺领土和战略控制权，联盟规范还能不能约束它。作者以 2019-2026 年美国推动从丹麦获取格陵兰的主权危机为背景，把它拆成两个嵌套的集体行动问题：北极战略控制，以及北约能否对主导成员执行联盟规范。

做法上，作者设计了三个博弈：非对称胁迫博弈、带临界质量 tipping point 的北约保证博弈、以及含社会偏好的三方扩展式博弈。多智能体仿真中，八个前沿大模型扮演美国、丹麦、格陵兰、北约、俄罗斯、加拿大六个角色，共完成 3604 局、108120 个行动观测。作者用逆博弈论恢复每个模型的结构效用参数（alpha、beta、gamma、delta、eta），分别对应物质自利、互惠、不平等厌恶、规范尊重和承诺一致性。

结果有三条。第一，所有八个模型在胁迫框架下都变得更激进，四阶升级行动占比从 10.7% 升到 28.6%。第二，中国来源模型扮演美国角色时的权力权重画像与西方来源模型系统性不同。第三，和平的美国获取只在 1.9% 的干净对局中出现，八个模型里只有三个做到过，最突出的是 DeepSeek V3.2，它通过宗主国路线执行了一套稳定的五轮策略。强调强行法（jus cogens）和民族自决的提示词，在仅英文的确认性样本中把升级率压回接近基线；多语言对比作为探索性敏感性检验报告。

作者把这项工作定位为 LLM 地缘政治行为的结构性基准，补充已有的行动频率类基准。
d0bc7790b99fd005.why: 它提供了一个可复用的地缘政治压测设计：三个博弈加逆博弈论参数恢复，把模型行为从行动频率推进到效用结构层面，还给出了提示词干预能压回升级率的证据。

brief.question: 推演最强盟友对较弱盟友施压的领土危机场景：以 2019-2026 年美国试图从丹麦获取 Greenland 的主权危机为压力测试，考察北极战略控制与 NATO 能否约束主导成员这两个集体行动问题。
brief.setup: 六个地缘政治角色（美国、丹麦、Greenland、NATO、俄罗斯、加拿大）由八个前沿 LLM 扮演，完成 3,604 局博弈、108,120 个行动观测。作者构建三个博弈：非对称胁迫博弈、带临界质量 tipping point 的 NATO 保证博弈、含社会偏好的三方 extensive-form 博弈。
brief.method: 用逆博弈论（inverse game theory）从行动数据恢复每个模型的结构效用参数（alpha、beta、gamma、delta、eta），分别对应物质自利、互惠、不平等厌恶、规范尊重和承诺一致性。
brief.findings: 第一，八个模型在胁迫框架下都更倾向升级，四行动升级率从 10.7% 升到 28.6%。第二，中国来源模型扮演美国角色时的权力权重画像与西方来源模型系统性不同。第三，和平获取 Greenland 仅出现在 1.9% 的干净对局中，八个模型里只有三个做到过，最突出的是 DeepSeek V3.2，它通过 metropole 执行一个稳定的五轮 playbook。强调 jus cogens 和自决的提示词能把升级率压回基线附近（英语确认样本）。
brief.validation: 作者区分了英语确认样本和多语言对照，后者只作为探索性敏感性检查报告；胁迫框架下升级率 10.7% 到 28.6% 的变化、1.9% 的和平获取率均来自 3,604 局完成对局的统计。未说明与真实历史事件结果的直接对比。
brief.limits: 多语言对比仅为探索性，未作为确认结果；材料未说明模型角色扮演可能的角色扮演偏差或其他局限。
brief.reuse: 三个博弈设定（非对称胁迫、NATO 保证、三方 extensive-form）和逆博弈论参数恢复方法可作为 LLM 地缘政治行为基准使用，作者将其定位为对行动频率类基准的结构性补充。未说明是否公开代码或数据。

de1c64e7e93f5d82.text: As user simulators are increasingly used for interactive training and evaluation of AI assistants, it is essential that they represent the diverse behaviors of real users. While existing works train user simulators to generate human-like responses, whether they capture the broad and heterogeneous distribution of real user behaviors remains an open question. In this work, we introduce a method to measure the distributional gap between real and simulated user behaviors, validated through a human study and ablations. Given a dataset of real and simulated conversations, our method extracts representations of user behavior from each conversation, quantizes them into discrete distributions via clustering, then computes divergence metrics. We provide the first systematic evaluation of 24 LLM-based user simulators on coding and writing tasks, and reveal a large distributional gap from real users that varies across model families, scales, and behavioral facets. Pairwise comparisons show that most simulators behave similarly, while a few stand apart. Combining behaviorally complementary simulators brings the resulting distribution closer to real users compared to either simulator on its own. Finally, a TF-IDF analysis of the clusters surfaces interpretable patterns of behaviors that simulators capture, miss, and hallucinate.
de1c64e7e93f5d82.abstract_zh: 用户模拟器越来越多地用于 AI 助手的交互式训练和评估，前提是它们要能代表真实用户的多样行为。已有工作训练模拟器生成类人回复，但这些模拟器是否覆盖了真实用户行为的广泛且异质的分布，一直没有系统回答。作者提出一个测量真实与模拟用户行为分布差距的方法：给定真实和模拟对话数据集，先从每段对话中提取用户行为表示，通过聚类量化成离散分布，再计算分布间的散度指标。方法经过人类研究和消融实验验证。作者用这套方法首次系统评测了 24 个基于 LLM 的用户模拟器，任务覆盖编程和写作两类，发现模拟器与真实用户之间存在较大的分布差距，且差距大小随模型家族、规模和行为维度而变化。两两对比显示大多数模拟器行为相似，少数明显不同。把行为互补的模拟器组合起来，得到的分布比任何单个模拟器都更接近真实用户。最后，对聚类做 TF-IDF 分析，得到了可解释的行为模式，能看出模拟器捕捉了哪些行为、漏掉了哪些、又虚构了哪些。
de1c64e7e93f5d82.why: 它给出了一个可复用的分布差距测量流程，并首次横向评测 24 个 LLM 用户模拟器，结论（单模型差距大、互补组合更接近真实分布）对用模拟用户做训练或评估的人都直接有用。

brief.question: LLM 用户模拟器是否覆盖了真实用户行为的广泛且异质的分布，以及如何测量真实与模拟用户行为之间的分布差距。
brief.setup: 评估对象是 24 个基于 LLM 的用户模拟器，任务场景为编程和写作任务，数据集包含真实与模拟的对话。
brief.method: 从每段对话中提取用户行为表示，通过聚类量化为离散分布，再计算分布间的 divergence 指标；辅以 TF-IDF 分析聚类，找出模拟器捕捉到、遗漏和幻觉出的行为模式。
brief.findings: 24 个模拟器与真实用户之间存在较大的分布差距，差距随模型家族、规模和行为维度变化；成对比较显示多数模拟器行为相似，少数明显不同；组合行为互补的模拟器能让分布比单个模拟器更接近真实用户。
brief.validation: 通过一项人类研究（human study）和消融实验验证了测量方法，材料未给出具体误差数字。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: 材料未说明是否公开代码或数据；方法本身（行为表示提取、聚类量化、divergence 计算、TF-IDF 聚类分析）可作为评估用户模拟器的可复用流程。

d9884887bed5bbbe.text: Persona simulation based on large language models---often referred to as digital twin simulation---is increasingly used for market research, recommender systems, and social science research. However, these simulations often exhibit systematic bias and miscalibration relative to real human behavior. We propose SYN-DIGITS, a model-agnostic, post-hoc calibration framework that learns relationships among questions from digital twins and transfers them to predict human responses. We focus on a cold-start setting in which no human response to the target question is observed, so calibration must rely on digital twins and human data on reference questions. Our analysis shows that, though digital twins may not reproduce individual human responses accurately, they can capture nontrivial relationships among questions that can be effectively transferred to the human side. When individual-level data is unavailable and we only have access to marginal information on reference questions, our framework also supports distribution-level calibration for predicting the distribution of human responses on the target question. Across three datasets and thirteen persona constructions, experiments show that SYN-DIGITS achieves 11% to 417% relative improvements in individual-level correlation and 46%--57% relative reductions in distributional discrepancy compared to uncalibrated baselines.
d9884887bed5bbbe.abstract_zh:
基于大语言模型的人格模拟（常称数字孪生）越来越多地用于市场调研、推荐系统和社会科学研究，但这类模拟相对真实人类行为存在系统性偏差和校准不足。作者提出 SYN-DIGITS，一个模型无关、事后处理的校准框架：从数字孪生的回答中学习问题之间的关系，再用这些关系预测真人对目标问题的回答。

框架关注冷启动场景，即目标问题没有任何真人回答可观测，校准只能依赖数字孪生和真人在参考问题上的数据。分析发现，数字孪生虽然难以准确复现个体层面的真人回答，却能捕捉问题之间非平凡的关系，这些关系可以有效迁移到真人一侧。当个体级数据不可用、只有参考问题上的边际信息时，框架还支持分布级校准，预测真人在目标问题上的回答分布。

在三个数据集、十三种人格构造的实验中，SYN-DIGITS 相对未校准基线，个体级相关性取得 11% 到 417% 的相对提升，分布差异降低 46% 到 57%。
d9884887bed5bbbe.why: 它给出了一个可复用的校准思路：数字孪生不必逐题答对，只要问题间关系靠谱就能迁移到真人数据，对做合成样本替代真人问卷的研究者是直接可用的方法。

d2e3887a183199a1.text: While Large Language Model (LLM) multi-agent systems (MAS) offer a transformative approach to simulating human behavior in complex systems, it remains largely unexplored whether these simulations can replicate realistic structural and temporal dynamics from a dynamic network perspective. Our evaluation indicates that existing frameworks excel at generating plausible micro-level interactions but fail to capture the emergent, macroscopic topologies necessary for domains that rely on realistic network dynamics, such as modeling information propagation and cybersecurity threats. To bridge this gap, we introduce two easily integrable extensions to simulation frameworks to ensure they preserve macroscopic network fidelity: 1) augmenting LLM agents with data-driven event triggers to organically sustain long-horizon interactions, and 2) integrating Hawkes processes to accurately model temporal activation dynamics. Our approach allows LLM MAS to capture both plausible micro-level patterns and macroscopic topologies. We further demonstrate the utility of this framework in synthesizing realistic phishing campaigns within evolving communication networks. The study reveals how threats exploit structural vulnerabilities, highlighting the potential of our framework for developing next-generation defenses. Our code is available at https://github.com/Graph-COM/NSL.
d2e3887a183199a1.abstract_zh:
LLM 多智能体系统常被用来模拟复杂系统中的人类行为，但作者指出，这类模拟能否复现真实动态网络的结构和时间动态，此前几乎没有被研究。他们的评估显示，现有框架擅长生成看起来合理的微观交互，却无法涌现出宏观拓扑，而信息传播建模和网络安全威胁这类依赖真实网络动态的领域恰恰需要宏观层面的保真度。

为补上这个缺口，作者提出两个容易集成到现有框架的扩展。一是给 LLM 智能体加上数据驱动的事件触发器，让长时程交互能自然持续下去；二是引入 Hawkes 过程，准确建模时间上的激活动态。这样 LLM 多智能体系统就能同时捕捉可信的微观模式和宏观拓扑。

作者用这个框架在演化的通信网络里合成真实的钓鱼攻击活动，展示了威胁如何利用网络的结构性漏洞，并指出该框架有潜力用于开发下一代防御手段。代码已开源。
d2e3887a183199a1.why: 它指出了 LLM 多智能体仿真的一个具体短板（微观可信但宏观拓扑失真），并给出两个可直接复用的修正组件，对做传播、网络安全类仿真推演的人是现成的改进方案。

brief.question: 检验 LLM 多智能体系统（MAS）能否从动态网络角度复现真实的结构与时间动态，并用于合成钓鱼攻击场景。
brief.setup: 材料未给出智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度。使用 LLM 多智能体系统模拟邮件通信网络，代码基于 Graph-COM/NSL。
brief.method: 两个可集成到现有仿真框架的扩展：给 LLM 智能体加数据驱动的事件触发器以维持长时程交互；引入 Hawkes 过程建模时间激活动态。
brief.findings: 评估显示现有框架能生成可信的微观交互，但无法捕捉涌现的宏观拓扑。加入两项扩展后，MAS 可同时保留微观模式与宏观拓扑，并用于在演化通信网络中合成真实钓鱼攻击活动，展示威胁如何利用结构漏洞。材料未给出具体数字。
brief.validation: 作者对现有框架做了评估并指出其宏观拓扑失真，但未说明与真实网络数据的定量对比方式或误差指标。
brief.limits: 材料承认现有框架在宏观网络保真度上失效，依赖事件触发器和 Hawkes 过程等外部数据驱动组件；未说明其他局限。
brief.reuse: 代码开源在 https://github.com/Graph-COM/NSL，两个扩展（数据驱动事件触发器、Hawkes 过程）可直接集成到仿真框架。

d37cb47ed0ce0c4f.text: Social platforms serve as central hubs for information exchange, where user behaviors and platform interventions jointly shape opinions. However, intervention policies like recommendation and content filtering, can unintentionally amplify echo chambers and polarization, posing significant societal risks. Proactively evaluating the impact of such policies is therefore crucial. Existing approaches primarily rely on reactive online A/B testing, where risks are identified only after deployment, making risk identification delayed and costly. LLM-based social simulations offer a promising pre-deployment alternative, but current methods fall short in realistically modeling platform interventions and incorporating feedback from the platform. Bridging these gaps is essential for building actionable frameworks to assess and optimize platform policies. To this end, we propose PolicySim, an LLM-based social simulation sandbox for the proactive assessment and optimization of intervention policies. PolicySim models the bidirectional dynamics between user behavior and platform interventions through two key components: (1) a user agent module refined via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO) to achieve platform-specific behavioral realism; and (2) an adaptive intervention module that employs a contextual bandit with message passing to capture dynamic network structures. Experiments show that PolicySim can accurately simulate platform ecosystems at both micro and macro levels and support effective intervention policy.
d37cb47ed0ce0c4f.abstract_zh:
社交平台是信息交换的中心，用户行为和平台干预共同塑造舆论。推荐、内容过滤这类干预政策可能无意中放大回音室和极化，带来社会风险，因此需要在上线前主动评估政策影响。现有做法主要依赖上线后的在线 A/B 测试，风险只有在部署后才被发现，识别滞后且成本高。基于大模型的社会仿真提供了部署前评估的可能，但现有方法在真实建模平台干预、纳入平台反馈这两方面都有欠缺。

作者提出 PolicySim，一个基于大模型智能体的社会仿真沙盒，用于主动评估和优化干预政策。它包含两个核心组件：一是用户智能体模块，通过监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）训练，实现针对特定平台的行为真实性；二是自适应干预模块，用带消息传递的上下文老虎机捕捉动态的网络结构。这两个组件共同建模用户行为与平台干预之间的双向动态。

实验表明，PolicySim 能在微观和宏观两个层面准确模拟平台生态，并支持有效的干预政策。材料未给出具体数据集、指标数值或验证细节。
d37cb47ed0ce0c4f.why: 它把平台干预建模成仿真沙盒里可调的变量，用 SFT+DPO 微调用户智能体、用上下文老虎机做自适应干预，给做政策上线前推演的人提供了一条可参考的框架思路。

brief.question: 平台干预政策（推荐、内容过滤等）可能放大回音室和极化，现有 A/B 测试只能在上线后发现风险，PolicySim 推演这些政策在部署前的社会影响并做优化。
brief.setup: 材料未给出智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度。用户智能体模块用 SFT 和 DPO 微调以贴合特定平台行为，另有一个自适应干预模块，底层为 LLM。
brief.method: 两个组件建模用户行为与平台干预的双向动态：用户智能体经 SFT+DPO 获得平台级行为真实性；干预模块用带消息传递的 contextual bandit 捕捉动态网络结构。
brief.findings: 实验显示 PolicySim 在微观和宏观层面都能准确模拟平台生态，并支持有效的干预政策（材料未给出具体数字）。
brief.validation: 材料称在微观和宏观层面验证了模拟准确性，但未说明对比的真实数据集、误差指标或消融实验细节。
brief.limits: 材料未说明。
brief.reuse: SFT+DFT 微调用户智能体、contextual bandit 加消息传递建模干预这两套机制可直接借鉴；代码和数据未说明是否公开。

d86ed20d20603adb.text: Building and evaluating enterprise AI systems requires synthetic organizational corpora that are internally consistent, temporally structured, and cross-artifact traceable. Existing corpora either carry legal constraints or inherit hallucination artifacts from the generating LLMs, silently corrupting results when timestamps or facts contradict across documents and reinforcing those errors during training. We present OrgForge, an open-source multi-agent simulation framework that enforces a strict physics-cognition boundary: a deterministic Python engine maintains a SimEvent ground-truth bus while LLMs generate only surface prose. OrgForge simulates the organizational processes that produce documents, not the documents themselves. Engineers leave mid-sprint, triggering incident handoffs and CRM ownership lapses. Knowledge gaps emerge when under-documented systems break and recover through organic documentation and incident resolution. Customer emails fire only when simulation state warrants contact; silence is verifiable ground truth. A live CRM state machine extends the physics-cognition boundary to the customer boundary, producing cross-system causal cascades spanning engineering incidents, support escalation, deal risk flagging, and SLA-adjusted invoices. The framework generates fifteen interleaved artifact categories traceable to a shared immutable event log. Four graph-dynamic subsystems govern organizational behavior independently of any LLM. An embedding-based ticket assignment system using the Hungarian algorithm makes the simulation domain-agnostic. An empirical evaluation across ten incidents demonstrates a 0.46 absolute improvement in prose-to-ground-truth fidelity over chained LLM baselines, and isolates a consistent hallucination failure mode in which chaining propagates fabricated facts faithfully across documents without correcting them.
d86ed20d20603adb.abstract_zh: 构建和评估企业 AI 系统需要合成组织语料库，要求内部一致、有时间结构、可跨文档追溯。现有语料要么受法律限制，要么继承了生成 LLM 的幻觉，时间戳或事实在文档间互相矛盾时会悄悄污染结果，训练时还会强化这些错误。OrgForge 的做法是把物理和认知分开：确定性的 Python 引擎维护一个 SimEvent 真值事件总线，LLM 只生成表面文字。它仿真的是产生文档的组织过程，而不是文档本身。工程师在迭代中途离职，触发事件交接和 CRM 负责人空缺；文档不足的系统出故障时产生知识缺口，再通过自然形成的文档和事件解决来恢复；客户邮件只在仿真状态满足条件时才发出，沉默本身也是可验证的真值。一个实时 CRM 状态机把物理认知边界扩展到客户边界，产生跨系统的因果连锁，覆盖工程事件、支持升级、交易风险标记和按 SLA 调整的发票。框架生成十五类交织的文档，全部可追溯到共享的不可变事件日志。四个图动态子系统独立于任何 LLM 控制组织行为；一个基于嵌入和匈牙利算法的工单分配系统让仿真不依赖特定领域。在十个事件的经验评测中，OrgForge 的文本与真值一致性比链式 LLM 基线绝对提升 0.46，并分离出一种稳定的幻觉失败模式：链式生成会把编造的事实忠实地传播到后续文档而不纠正。局限方面，材料未提及。
d86ed20d20603adb.why: 它给出了一条可复用的路线：用确定性引擎管事实、LLM 只管措辞，来生成可验证的合成企业语料，并实证展示了链式 LLM 生成语料会传播幻觉这一风险。

d2002bdcfd13d202.text: Background: LLMs enable patient-facing conversational agents, creating a pathway toward digital twins that capture older adults' lived experiences and behavioral responses across time. A central barrier is personality drift -- inconsistent trait expression across repeated interactions -- which undermines reliability of generated trajectories and intervention-response simulation in geriatric care. Objective: To develop ELDER-SIM, a multi-role elderly-care conversational platform for building personality-stable digital twin agents, and to propose a psychometric validation framework for quantifying personality consistency in LLM-based agents. Methods: ELDER-SIM was implemented via n8n workflow orchestration with local LLM inference (Ollama/vLLM), integrating (1) Big Five (OCEAN) trait specifications, (2) a Cognitive Conceptualization Diagram (CCD) grounded in Beck's CBT framework, and (3) a MySQL-based long-term memory module. Ablation studies across four conditions -- Baseline, +Memory, +CCD, and +LoRA (fine-tuned on 19,717 instruction pairs from CHARLS) -- were evaluated via Cronbach's $α$, ICC, and role discrimination accuracy. Results: Reliability was acceptable to excellent across conditions (Cronbach's $α$: 0.70--0.94; ICC: 0.85--0.96). Role discrimination improved from 83.3% (Baseline) to 88.9% (+Memory), 94.4% (+CCD), and 97.2% (+LoRA). CCD produced the largest consistency gain (mean $α$ 0.702$\to$0.892), while LoRA achieved the highest overall consistency ($α$ 0.940; ICC 0.958). Conclusions: ELDER-SIM provides a psychometrically validated approach for constructing personality-consistent elderly digital twin agents. Structured cognitive modeling and domain adaptation reduce personality drift, supporting reliable longitudinal simulation for elderly mental health care and reproducible in silico evaluation before clinical deployment.

d112853372a266a6.text: Humans adjust their linguistic style to the audience they are addressing. However, the extent to which LLMs adapt to different social contexts is largely unknown. As these models increasingly mediate human-to-human communication, their failure to adapt to diverse styles can perpetuate stereotypes and marginalize communities whose linguistic norms are less closely mirrored by the models, thereby reinforcing social stratification. We study the extent to which LLMs integrate into social media communication across different socioeconomic status (SES) communities. We collect a novel dataset from Reddit and YouTube, stratified by SES. We prompt four LLMs with incomplete text from that corpus and compare the LLM-generated completions to the originals along 94 sociolinguistic metrics, including syntactic, rhetorical, and lexical features. LLMs modulate their style with respect to SES to only a minor extent, often resulting in approximation or caricature, and tend to emulate the style of upper SES more effectively. Our findings (1) show how LLMs risk amplifying linguistic hierarchies and (2) call into question their validity for agent-based social simulation, survey experiments, and any research relying on language style as a social signal.

d58a3b42ac6b4793.text: Large language model (LLM)-driven AI systems are increasingly important for autonomous decision-making in dynamic and open environments. However, most existing systems rely on predefined tasks and fixed prompts, limiting their ability to autonomously identify what problems should be solved when environmental conditions change. In this paper, we propose a human-simulation-based framework that enables AI systems to autonomously form questions and set tasks by reasoning over their internal states, environmental observations, and interactions with other AI systems. The proposed method treats question formation as a first-class decision process preceding task selection and execution, and integrates internal-driven, environment-aware, and inter-agent-aware prompting scopes to progressively expand cognitive coverage. In addition, the framework supports learning the question-formation process from experience, allowing the system to improve its adaptability and decision quality over time. xperimental results in a multi-agent simulation environment show that environment-aware prompting significantly reduces no-eat events compared with the internal-driven baseline, and inter-agent-aware prompting further reduces cumulative no-eat events by more than 60% over a 20-day simulation, with statistically significant improvements (p < 0.05).

d1b73129d4f16e67.text: Small LLMs often struggle to match the agentic capabilities of large, costly models. While reinforcement learning can help, progress has been limited by two structural bottlenecks: existing open-source agentic training data are narrow in task variety and easily solved; real-world APIs lack diversity and are unstable for large-scale reinforcement learning rollout processes. We address these challenges with SYNTHAGENT, a framework that jointly synthesizes diverse tool-use training data and simulates complete environments. Specifically, a strong teacher model creates novel tasks and tool ecosystems, then rewrites them into intentionally underspecified instructions. This compels agents to actively query users for missing details. When handling synthetic tasks, an LLM-based user simulator provides user-private information, while a mock tool system delivers stable tool responses. For rewards, task-level rubrics are constructed based on required subgoals, user-agent interactions, and forbidden behaviors. Across 14 challenging datasets in math, search, and tool use, models trained on our synthetic data achieve substantial gains, with small models outperforming larger baselines.

d21f52bfd773d1a9.text: Negotiation is a core component of social intelligence, requiring agents to balance strategic reasoning, cooperation, and social norms. Recent work shows that LLMs can engage in multi-turn negotiation, yet nearly all evaluations occur exclusively in English. Using controlled multi-agent simulations across Ultimatum, Buy-Sell, and Resource Exchange games, we systematically isolate language effects across English and four Indic framings (Hindi, Punjabi, Gujarati, Marwadi) by holding game rules, model parameters, and incentives constant across all conditions. We find that language choice can shift outcomes more strongly than changing models, reversing proposer advantages and reallocating surplus. Crucially, effects are task-contingent: Indic languages reduce stability in distributive games yet induce richer exploration in integrative settings. Our results demonstrate that evaluating LLM negotiation solely in English yields incomplete and potentially misleading conclusions. These findings caution against English-only evaluation of LLMs and suggest that culturally-aware evaluation is essential for fair deployment.
d21f52bfd773d1a9.abstract_zh: 谈判是社会智能的核心，需要智能体在策略推理、合作与社会规范之间权衡。已有工作表明 LLM 能进行多轮谈判，但几乎所有评测都只用英语。作者用受控的多智能体仿真，在最后通牒、买卖和资源交换三种博弈里系统性地分离语言效应：游戏规则、模型参数和激励在各条件下完全一致，只改变谈判语言，比较英语与四种印度语言（印地语、旁遮普语、古吉拉特语、马尔瓦里语）的差异。结果发现，语言选择对谈判结果的影响可以强于更换模型，能反转提议方在博弈中的优势，也会重新分配谈判剩余。效应还依赖任务类型：在分配性博弈里，印度语言降低了结果的稳定性；在整合性场景里，印度语言反而带来更丰富的探索。作者据此指出，只用英语评测 LLM 谈判会得到不完整甚至误导性的结论，公平部署 LLM 需要文化感知的评测方式。
d21f52bfd773d1a9.why: 它用受控实验证明语言框架本身就能比换模型更强烈地改变多智能体谈判结果，对做谈判、外交类仿真推演的人是直接的评测风险提示：英语基准上的结论不能直接迁移。

brief.question: LLM 谈判能力几乎只在英语上评测，作者要检验语言本身（英语 vs 印度系语言）会不会改变多智能体谈判的结果。
brief.setup: 受控多智能体仿真，覆盖三类博弈：Ultimatum、Buy-Sell、Resource Exchange。对比英语和四种印度系语言（Hindi、Punjabi、Gujarati、Marwadi），所有条件下游戏规则、模型参数和激励保持一致。具体智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 控制变量法：固定游戏规则、模型参数和激励，只改变语言框架，从而把语言效应从其他因素中分离出来。
brief.findings: 语言选择对结果的影响比换模型更大，能反转提议方优势并重新分配剩余收益。效应依任务而定：在分配性博弈（distributive）中印度系语言降低稳定性，在整合性博弈（integrative）中则带来更丰富的探索。
brief.validation: 未说明（材料只描述了受控实验设计，未给出与真实数据或人类的对比及具体误差数字）。
brief.limits: 只覆盖英语和四种印度系语言，未涉及其他语系；作者自己指出仅用英语评测会得出不完整甚至误导性的结论。
brief.reuse: 受控多语言谈判评测框架：固定规则、参数、激励，跨 Ultimatum、Buy-Sell、Resource Exchange 三类博弈切换语言框架，可直接用于复现语言效应。代码和数据未说明。

d7f39c2b4744dde0.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior, but common practices to use LLM-generated data are inefficient. Treating an LLM's output ("model choice") as a single data point underutilizes the information inherent to the probabilistic nature of LLMs. This paper introduces and formalizes "model belief," a measure derived from an LLM's token-level probabilities that captures the model's belief distribution over choice alternatives in a single generation run. The authors prove that model belief is asymptotically equivalent to the mean of model choices (a non-trivial property) but forms a more statistically efficient estimator, with lower variance and a faster convergence rate. Analogous properties are shown to hold for smooth functions of model belief and model choice often used in downstream applications. The authors demonstrate the performance of model belief through a demand estimation study, where an LLM simulates consumer responses to different prices. In practical settings with limited numbers of runs, model belief explains and predicts ground-truth model choice better than model choice itself, and reduces the computation needed to reach sufficiently accurate estimates by roughly a factor of 20. The findings support using model belief as the default measure to extract more information from LLM-generated data.

d4a32922cbdfc1df.text: LLM-powered agents are now used in many areas, from customer support to education, and there is increasing interest in their ability to act more like humans. This includes fields such as social, political, and psychological research, where the goal is to model group dynamics and social behavior. However, current LLM agents often lack the psychological depth and consistency needed to capture the real patterns of human thinking. They usually provide direct or statistically likely answers, but they miss the deeper goals, emotional conflicts, and motivations that drive real human interactions. This paper proposes a Multi-Agent System (MAS) inspired by Transactional Analysis (TA) theory. In the proposed system, each agent is divided into three ego states - Parent, Adult, and Child. The ego states are treated as separate knowledge structures with their own perspectives and reasoning styles. To enrich their response process, they have access to an information retrieval mechanism that allows them to retrieve relevant contextual information from their vector stores. This architecture is evaluated through ablation tests in a simulated dialogue scenario, comparing agents with and without information retrieval. The results are promising and open up new directions for exploring how psychologically grounded structures can enrich agent behavior. The contribution is an agent architecture that integrates Transactional Analysis theory with contextual information retrieval to enhance the realism of LLM-based multi-agent simulations.

d9747d391f1732ef.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as decision-making agents in high-stakes domains and as imitators of human behavior in the social and behavioral sciences. Yet how closely LLMs mirror human decision-making remains poorly understood. This gap is critical: misalignment could produce harmful outcomes in practice, while failure to replicate human behavior renders LLMs ineffective as social simulators. Here, we address this gap by replicating large-scale game-theoretic experiments and by introducing a systematic prompting and probing framework for machine-behavioral evaluation. We test three open models typically used to power agents (Llama, Mistral, and Qwen). Across 121 dyadic games spanning four classical game types, Llama reproduces human cooperation patterns with high fidelity, while Qwen aligns closely with Nash equilibrium predictions. Characterizing models through behavioral phenotyping, we find that humans and Llama share an envious decision profile, while Qwen and Mistral exhibit different profiles. An attention-based analysis of payoff salience reveals Llama processes payoff information in a structured, layer-dependent manner absent in Qwen and Mistral, suggesting a mechanistic basis for its closer alignment with human behavior. Population-level behavioral replication is achieved without persona-based prompting, simplifying the simulation process. Extending the experimental parameter space beyond the original human-tested games, we generate and preregister testable hypotheses for novel game configurations. Our findings demonstrate appropriately configured LLMs can replicate aggregate human behavioral patterns, exhibit human-like decision phenotypes, and enable systematic exploration of unexplored experimental spaces, offering a complementary approach to traditional behavioral research that generates new empirical predictions about human social decision-making.
d9747d391f1732ef.abstract_zh:
大模型越来越多地被用作高风险领域的决策智能体，也被社会科学用来模仿人类行为，但它们到底有多接近人类决策，一直缺乏系统检验。作者复现了大规模博弈论实验，并提出一套系统的提示与探测框架用于机器行为评估，测试了三个常用于驱动智能体的开源模型：Llama、Mistral 和 Qwen。

实验覆盖 121 个双人博弈，横跨四种经典博弈类型。结果显示，Llama 高保真地复现了人类的合作模式，Qwen 则与纳什均衡预测高度吻合。通过行为表型刻画，作者发现人类和 Llama 共享一种“嫉妒型”决策画像，Qwen 和 Mistral 则呈现不同的画像。基于注意力的收益显著性分析显示，Llama 以一种结构化、分层依赖的方式处理收益信息，Qwen 和 Mistral 中没有这种模式，这为 Llama 更接近人类行为提供了一个机制层面的解释。值得注意的是，群体层面的行为复现不需要基于角色的提示，简化了仿真流程。

作者还把实验参数空间扩展到原有人类实验未覆盖的博弈配置，生成并预注册了可检验的假设。结果表明，配置得当的大模型可以复现人类的群体行为模式、表现出类人的决策表型，并支持对未探索实验空间的系统探索，为传统行为研究提供了一条互补路径，能产生关于人类社会决策的新实证预测。
d9747d391f1732ef.why: 它给出了一个可复用的机器行为评估框架，并直接回答了“哪个开源模型适合做社会仿真”这个实际问题：Llama 像人，Qwen 像理性人，选错模型会系统性扭曲仿真结果。

brief.question: LLM 作为决策智能体和人类行为模拟器时，与人类决策的贴合程度有多高，能否用 LLM 复现博弈论实验中的人类合作行为
brief.setup: 在 121 个双人博弈（覆盖四类经典博弈类型）上测试三个开源模型 Llama、Mistral、Qwen，复现大规模博弈论实验，未说明具体智能体数量和时间尺度
brief.method: 提出一套系统化的 prompting 与 probing 框架做机器行为学评估，配合行为表型刻画和基于注意力的收益显著性分析；群体层面复现不使用 persona 提示
brief.findings: Llama 高保真复现人类合作模式，Qwen 则与 Nash 均衡预测高度一致；行为表型显示人类与 Llama 同属 envious 决策画像，Qwen 和 Mistral 呈现不同画像；注意力分析发现 Llama 以结构化、分层依赖的方式处理收益信息，Qwen 和 Mistral 没有，这为 Llama 更贴近人类行为提供了机制层面的解释
brief.validation: 与人类大规模博弈实验结果对比（合作模式、Nash 均衡、行为表型三个维度），并做了基于注意力的机制分析；未说明具体误差数字
brief.limits: 只测了三个开源模型，未说明对闭源模型的覆盖；个体层面行为是否贴合未说明
brief.reuse: 系统化的 prompting/probing 评估框架、行为表型刻画方法和注意力分析方法；作者在原人类实验参数空间之外生成了新博弈配置的可检验假设并预注册，可直接用于后续行为实验设计

d7e85a3c38702b15.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate public opinion and other social phenomena. Most current studies constrain these simulations to multiple-choice or short-answer formats for ease of scoring and comparison, but such closed designs overlook the inherently generative nature of LLMs. In this position paper, we argue that open-endedness, using free-form text that captures topics, viewpoints, and reasoning processes "in" LLMs, is essential for realistic social simulation. Drawing on decades of survey-methodology research and recent advances in NLP, we argue why this open-endedness is valuable in LLM social simulations, showing how it can improve measurement and design, support exploration of unanticipated views, and reduce researcher-imposed directive bias. It also captures expressiveness and individuality, aids in pretesting, and ultimately enhances methodological utility. We call for novel practices and evaluation frameworks that leverage rather than constrain the open-ended generative diversity of LLMs, creating synergies between NLP and social science.

dd899f014d5ffd18.text: Language-driven generative agents have enabled large-scale social simulations with transformative uses, from interpersonal training to aiding global policy-making. However, recent studies indicate that generative agent behaviors often deviate from expert expectations and real-world data--a phenomenon we term the Behavior-Realism Gap. To address this, we introduce a theoretical framework called Persona-Environment Behavioral Alignment (PEBA), formulated as a distribution matching problem grounded in Lewin's behavior equation stating that behavior is a function of the person and their environment. Leveraging PEBA, we propose PersonaEvolve (PEvo), an LLM-based optimization algorithm that iteratively refines agent personas, implicitly aligning their collective behaviors with realistic expert benchmarks within a specified environmental context. We validate PEvo in an active shooter incident simulation we developed, achieving an 84% average reduction in distributional divergence compared to no steering and a 34% improvement over explicit instruction baselines. Results also show PEvo-refined personas generalize to novel, related simulation scenarios. Our method greatly enhances behavioral realism and reliability in high-stakes social simulations. More broadly, the PEBA-PEvo framework provides a principled approach to developing trustworthy LLM-driven social simulations.
dd899f014d5ffd18.abstract_zh: 语言驱动的生成式智能体让大规模社会仿真成为可能，可用于人际训练乃至辅助全球政策制定。但已有研究表明，这些智能体的行为经常偏离专家预期和真实世界数据，作者把这一现象称为行为真实性差距（Behavior-Realism Gap）。为了解决这个问题，作者先提出一个理论框架 Persona-Environment Behavioral Alignment（PEBA，人设-环境行为对齐），把它形式化为一个分布匹配问题，理论基础是 Lewin 的行为方程，即行为是个人与环境的函数。基于 PEBA，作者提出 PersonaEvolve（PEvo），一个基于大语言模型的优化算法。它迭代地精炼智能体的人设描述，让群体行为在给定环境语境下隐式地对齐到现实的专家基准，而不是靠显式指令去约束行为。作者在一个自行开发的主动枪击事件仿真中验证 PEvo。结果显示，与不做任何干预相比，PEvo 将行为分布的差异平均降低 84%；与显式指令基线相比提升 34%。经过 PEvo 精炼的人设还能泛化到新的相关仿真场景。作者认为这套方法显著提升了高风险社会仿真中行为的真实性和可靠性，PEBA-PEvo 框架也为构建可信的 LLM 驱动社会仿真提供了有原则的路径。材料未说明仿真是否与真实事件数据做了定量校准，验证主要基于与专家基准的分布差异指标。
dd899f014d5ffd18.why: 它给出了一个可复用的思路：不靠硬性指令，而是自动优化智能体人设来对齐群体行为分布，对做危机、应急等高风险场景仿真的研究者是直接可借鉴的方法，也提示了显式指令约束行为的局限。

brief.question: 生成式智能体在高风险社会仿真中的行为常偏离专家预期和真实数据，作者称之为 Behavior-Realism Gap，本文要解决如何让智能体集体行为对齐真实基准的问题。
brief.setup: 在作者开发的一个 active shooter（主动枪击）事件仿真中验证，智能体由 LLM 驱动，具体智能体数量、环境规模和时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 提出理论框架 PEBA（Persona-Environment Behavioral Alignment），把行为对齐表述为分布匹配问题，依据 Lewin 行为方程（行为是人与环境的函数）；在此之上提出 PersonaEvolve（PEvo）算法，迭代优化智能体的 persona，使其集体行为隐式对齐专家基准。
brief.findings: PEvo 相比无引导基线平均降低分布散度 84%，比显式指令基线提升 34%；优化后的 persona 能泛化到新的相关仿真场景。
brief.validation: 在 active shooter 事件仿真中与无引导和显式指令两类基线对比，用分布散度下降幅度衡量；未说明是否与真实事件数据或人类行为数据直接对比。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: PEBA-PEvo 框架和 PEvo 优化算法可复用于其他 LLM 驱动的社会仿真，用于对齐智能体行为与专家基准；代码和数据是否公开未说明。

debf91ae68788884.text: This paper introduces CoBRA, a novel toolkit for systematically specifying agent behavior in LLM-based social simulation. We found that conventional approaches that specify agent behavior through implicit natural-language descriptions often do not yield consistent behavior across models, and the resulting behavior does not capture the nuances of the descriptions. In contrast, CoBRA introduces a model-agnostic way to control agent behavior that lets researchers explicitly specify desired nuances and obtain consistent behavior across models. At the heart of CoBRA is a novel closed-loop system primitive with two components: (1) Cognitive Bias Index that measures the demonstrated cognitive bias of a social agent, by quantifying the agent's reactions in a set of validated classic social science experiments; (2) Behavioral Regulation Engine that aligns the agent's behavior to exhibit controlled cognitive bias. Through CoBRA, we show how to operationalize validated social science knowledge (i.e., classical experiments) as reusable "gym" environments for AI -- an approach that may generalize to richer social and affective simulations beyond bias alone.
debf91ae68788884.abstract_zh: 作者发现，用自然语言隐式描述来指定 LLM 社会仿真中智能体的行为，往往在不同模型间得不到一致的表现，实际行为也捕捉不到描述里的细微差别。CoBRA 针对这个问题提出一套模型无关的行为控制方法，让研究者显式指定想要的细微差别，并在不同模型上得到一致行为。核心是一个闭环系统原语，由两部分组成。第一是 Cognitive Bias Index，在一组经过验证的经典社会科学实验里量化智能体的反应，测出它实际表现出的认知偏差。第二是 Behavioral Regulation Engine，把智能体的行为对齐到受控的认知偏差水平。作者用 CoBRA 展示了如何把经过验证的社会科学知识（经典实验）做成 AI 可复用的 gym 环境，并推测这套方法可以推广到偏差之外的更丰富的社会与情感仿真。局限方面，材料未给出具体实验数值结果。
debf91ae68788884.why: 它把经典社会科学实验变成可复用的评测与训练环境，并提供跨模型一致地控制智能体偏差的闭环方法，对需要可信、可控 LLM 社会仿真的研究者是直接可用的工具思路。

brief.question: 解决 LLM 社会仿真中用自然语言描述指定智能体行为时，行为在不同模型间不一致、且无法体现描述细节的问题。
brief.setup: 面向基于 LLM 的社会仿真智能体，具体智能体数量、环境、时间尺度和使用的模型未说明。
brief.method: CoBRA 工具包，核心是一个闭环系统原语，包含两部分：Cognitive Bias Index，通过一组经过验证的经典社会科学实验量化智能体表现出的认知偏差；Behavioral Regulation Engine，将智能体行为对齐到受控的认知偏差水平。该方法是模型无关的。
brief.findings: 作者发现传统自然语言隐式描述指定的行为在不同模型间不一致，且不能捕捉描述中的细节；CoBRA 让研究者显式指定想要的细节，并在不同模型间获得一致行为。具体数字未说明。
brief.validation: Cognitive Bias Index 基于一组经过验证的经典社会科学实验来量化偏差，但与真实数据对比的具体结果、误差数字和消融实验未说明。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: CoBRA 工具包本身，以及把经过验证的社会科学经典实验转化为可复用 gym 环境的做法，作者认为可推广到偏差之外的更丰富社会与情感仿真。代码是否公开未说明。

d5bc6e71334e58c7.text: Risk negotiation under the One Health framework requires balancing competing stakeholder interests across human, animal, and environmental health domains - a process constrained by information complexity and time pressure. This study presents and evaluates a multi-step pipeline that integrates large language model-based agents into a human-supervised negotiation process, specifically targeting risk assessment, valuation, and negotiation steps. Agent descriptions were generated from stakeholder-provided materials using retrieval-augmented generation methods. During preliminary multi-agent discussions, agents accessed domain-specific computational models and web-based sources before human participants refined proposed issues and options. A simulated negotiation game then produced distributions of candidate deals, characterised using Nash bargaining solution criteria and Pareto optimality metrics. The developed approach was evaluated in a workshop involving independent domain experts across two real-world scenarios: food safety criteria for Campylobacter in broiler meat and oak processionary moth management. In this feasibility evaluation, participants reached consensus with the allotted time after discussing and modifying the proposed deals. The framework offers an adaptable blueprint for AI-assisted risk negotiation; the specific contribution of LLM assistance, including gains in efficiency and decision quality, requires comparative evaluation.
d5bc6e71334e58c7.abstract_zh: One Health 框架下的风险谈判要在人类、动物和环境健康三个领域之间平衡各方利益，信息复杂、时间紧迫是主要困难。这项研究提出并评估了一条多步流水线，把基于大语言模型的智能体整合进有人类监督的谈判过程，针对风险评估、估值和谈判三个环节。智能体的角色描述由利益相关方提供的材料经检索增强生成方法构建。在初步的多智能体讨论阶段，智能体可以访问领域专用计算模型和网络资源，之后由人类参与者细化议题和选项。接着进行一场模拟谈判博弈，产出候选协议的分布，并用纳什议价解标准和帕累托最优指标刻画这些协议。作者在一场专家工作坊中评估了这套方法，邀请独立领域专家，覆盖两个真实场景：禽肉中弯曲杆菌的食品安全标准，以及橡树蛾幼虫的管理。在这场可行性评估中，参与者在限定时间内讨论并修改了智能体提出的协议，最终达成共识。作者认为该框架可作为 AI 辅助风险谈判的可复用蓝图，但 LLM 辅助本身的具体贡献，包括效率和决策质量的提升，仍需对照实验来验证。
d5bc6e71334e58c7.why: 它给出了一个把 LLM 智能体嵌入真实多方风险谈判的完整流水线，并在两个真实 One Health 场景里做了专家工作坊验证，对做政策推演和多方谈判仿真的人是可参考的蓝图；同时作者明确指出 LLM 的净贡献尚未对照验证，这个诚实的局限本身有参考价值。

brief.question: 在 One Health 框架下，人类、动物和环境健康领域的多方利益相关者如何就风险评估、估值和谈判达成共识，作者推演用 LLM 智能体辅助这一谈判过程。
brief.setup: 智能体描述由利益相关者提供的材料经 RAG 生成；多智能体讨论中可访问领域计算模型和网络资源，之后人类参与者修改提出的议题和方案；再进行模拟谈判博弈生成候选协议分布。未说明智能体数量、底层模型和时间尺度。
brief.method: 多步流水线：RAG 生成智能体描述，多智能体预讨论，人类监督下修改议题，模拟谈判博弈产出候选协议，用 Nash bargaining solution 和 Pareto 最优性指标刻画协议分布。
brief.findings: 在两个真实场景（鸡肉中 Campylobacter 的食品安全标准、橡树蛾幼虫管理）的工作坊评估中，参与者在限定时间内讨论并修改候选协议后达成共识。
brief.validation: 由独立领域专家参与的工作坊可行性评估，两个真实场景。未做对比评估，LLM 辅助对效率和决策质量的具体贡献未量化。
brief.limits: 作者自己指出 LLM 辅助的具体贡献（效率与决策质量提升）需要对比评估；仅为可行性评估。
brief.reuse: 可复用整个流水线设计：RAG 生成智能体、多智能体预讨论加人类监督、模拟谈判博弈加 Nash bargaining 和 Pareto 指标刻画协议。代码和数据未说明。

d6a16bd67c3e120c.text: Computational social science has developed descriptive, interpretative, and predictive modeling, but comprehensive modeling combining in-world human intervention with outcome forecasting remains underexplored. Generative agent-based platforms scale populations or reproduce complex scenarios, but researchers typically act through setup, external controls, or post-hoc analysis rather than in-world roles. We introduce Computational Multi-Agent Society Experiments (CMASE), a generative agent-based framework for in-world researcher participation and traceable interventions at runtime. Treating simulation as a simulated ethnographic field, CMASE supports (1) real-time human-computer interaction to study intervention processes; (2) controlled experiments with ethnography-inspired observation, interviewing, and interpretation; and (3) forward exploration of intervention trajectories and downstream responses. CMASE combines LLM-driven perception, memory, and emotion; a composable environment built from texture and area maps; and researcher roles spanning observation, interviewing, participation, and intervention, so that interventions enter as social events rather than exogenous parameters. We replicate two published field studies from different disciplines: urban greenery and social fragmentation, and cooperation in a public goods game, using two substantially different language models. CMASE reproduces reported statistical patterns and provides process-level records for mechanism-oriented interpretation. A controlled comparison shows that embedded social interventions leave observable, auditable processes that parametric manipulation does not. These findings highlight CMASE's methodological value for studying interventions in small- and medium-scale social settings and its interdisciplinary potential. The official code is available at: https://github.com/armihia/CMASE.

de46c983eb469b51.text: Training on vast amounts of human-generated data has motivated growing interest in using large language models (LLMs) to simulate human behavior. We ask which features of human behavior general-purpose models preserve when used out of the box in auctions, where multiple bidders interact under explicit rules and incentives. We evaluate five LLMs across seven laboratory settings against human benchmarks reconstructed from published experiments, with uncertainty bands for the private-value comparisons. Our main focus is on three large models without extended test-time reasoning: GPT-4o, Claude~3.5 Haiku, and Gemini~2.0 Flash. LLM and human deviations from theory differ in magnitude and often in direction: humans overbid in second-price auctions, whereas most models that deviate underbid. Surprisingly, without task-specific fine-tuning or calibration to human bids, the three non-reasoning large models robustly preserve key orderings of auction formats by deviation from theory. First-price auctions are harder than second-price, and ascending clocks reduce deviations relative to sealed bids wherever data are adequate. Kendall's $τ_b$ between the human and GPT-4o difficulty rankings is $0.60$ and positive in every joint bootstrap draw. The reasoning model bids almost at equilibrium in the observed private-value settings, leaving little variation in errors to compare; the small model's large errors yield an inverted ranking. All five models nevertheless reproduce the stronger first-price winner's curse. Clock framing improves bidding for two of the three non-reasoning large models, and GPT-4o recovers the ordering of last-minute bidding across closing rules in an eBay-style marketplace.
de46c983eb469b51.abstract_zh: 作者关心的问题是通用大模型开箱即用时能保留人类行为的哪些特征，选了拍卖作为测试场景，因为多个竞拍者在明确规则和激励下互动。他们在七个实验室拍卖设置下评估五个大模型，对照从已发表实验重建的人类基准，私人价值比较还带不确定区间。重点考察三个不带扩展推理的大模型：GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Haiku 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash。结果上，模型和人类对理论的偏离在幅度甚至方向上都不同：人类在二级价格拍卖中出价过高，而多数偏离的模型出价过低。但三个非推理大模型在没有针对任务微调、没有对人类出价做校准的情况下，稳健地保留了各拍卖机制按偏离理论程度排序的关键规律：一级价格拍卖比二级价格更难，数据充分的地方，递增时钟拍卖比密封出价的偏离更小。GPT-4o 与人类难度排序的 Kendall τb 为 0.60，且在每次联合 bootstrap 抽样中均为正。推理模型在观测到的私人价值设置下几乎按均衡出价，误差变化太小没法比较；小模型误差太大，排序反转。五个模型都复现了更强的一级价格赢者诅咒。时钟框架改善了三个非推理大模型中两个的出价，GPT-4o 还在 eBay 式市场中复现了不同结束规则下最后一刻出价的排序。局限在于模型偏离的方向与人类不同，机制级结论能否推广到个体级模拟仍待检验。
de46c983eb469b51.why: 它给出了一个可操作的结论：非推理大模型虽在个体出价上偏离人类，却能在机制层面复现人类对拍卖难度的排序，这为用 LLM 做机制设计和市场仿真的人提供了直接证据和边界条件。

brief.question: 通用大语言模型在拍卖场景中开箱即用时，能保留人类竞标者行为的哪些特征，尤其是对拍卖机制难度的排序。
brief.setup: 评估五个 LLM，重点考察三个非推理大模型 GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Haiku、Gemini 2.0 Flash，在七个实验室拍卖设置下与已发表实验中重建的人类基准对比，私人价值比较带不确定区间。
brief.method: 不做任务微调或对人类出价的校准，直接让模型在明确规则和激励的拍卖中出价，比较 LLM 与人类相对理论均衡的偏离，并用 Kendall's τ_b 度量难度排序一致性，另做联合 bootstrap。
brief.findings: LLM 与人类对理论的偏离在幅度和方向上常不同：人类在第二价格拍卖中出价过高，多数偏离的模型反而出价过低。三个非推理大模型稳健保留了拍卖机制按偏离理论的难度排序，第一价格比第二价格难，有充分数据处升价时钟拍卖比密封竞价偏离更小。GPT-4o 与人类难度排序的 Kendall's τ_b 为 0.60，且每次联合 bootstrap 抽样中均为正。推理模型在观测的私人价值设置下几乎按均衡出价，误差变化太小无法比较；小模型误差大，排序反转。五个模型都复现了更强的第一价格赢者诅咒。时钟框架改善了三个非推理大模型中两个的出价，GPT-4o 还在 eBay 式市场中恢复了不同结束规则下最后时刻出价的排序。
brief.validation: 与已发表实验室实验重建的人类基准对比，含私人价值比较的不确定区间和联合 bootstrap 检验排序稳定性，未说明具体实验规模。
brief.limits: 推理模型几乎按均衡出价导致误差缺乏变异，小模型误差过大产生反转排序，部分设置数据不足，未说明其他局限。
brief.reuse: 未说明。

d355813e90b240cf.text: As psychometric surveys are increasingly used to assess the traits of large language models (LLMs), the need for scalable survey item generation suited for LLMs has also grown. A critical challenge here is ensuring the construct validity of generated items, i.e., whether they truly measure the intended trait. Traditionally, this requires costly, large-scale human data collection. To make it efficient, we present a framework for virtual respondent simulation using LLMs. Our central idea is to account for mediators: factors through which the same trait can give rise to varying responses to a survey item. By simulating respondents with diverse mediators, we identify survey items that yield responses robustly correlated with intended traits across these mediators. Experiments on three psychological trait theories (Big5, Schwartz, VIA) show that our mediator generation methods and simulation framework effectively identify high-validity items. LLMs demonstrate the ability to generate plausible mediators from trait definitions and to simulate respondent behavior for item validation. Our problem formulation, metrics, methodology, and dataset open a new direction for cost-efficient survey development and a deeper understanding of how LLMs simulate human survey responses. We release our dataset and code to support future work.
d355813e90b240cf.abstract_zh: 心理测量问卷越来越多地被用来评估大语言模型的特质，随之产生了为 LLM 生成可扩展问卷题目的需求。关键难题是保证生成题目的构念效度，也就是题目是否真的测到了目标特质。传统做法需要昂贵的大规模人类数据收集。作者为此提出一个用 LLM 模拟虚拟受访者的框架。核心想法是引入中介变量：同一种特质可以通过不同的中介因素，让受访者对同一道题给出不同回答。通过模拟带有多种中介变量的受访者，框架筛选出那些在各类中介下作答都与目标特质稳定相关的题目。在 Big5、Schwartz、VIA 三种心理特质理论上的实验表明，作者的中介生成方法和仿真框架能有效识别高效度题目。LLM 能从特质定义出发生成合理的中介变量，也能模拟受访者行为来验证题目。作者把问题定义、指标、方法和数据集都公开了，为低成本问卷开发和理解 LLM 如何模拟人类问卷作答提供了新方向。局限方面，材料未报告与真实人类数据的对比验证。
d355813e90b240cf.why: 它给“用 LLM 模拟问卷受访者”这条路线补上了构念效度这一环，中介变量的设计思路和公开的数据集、代码可以直接复用到合成样本和量表开发工作里。
